list: The official 55 trophies, 2026-11-18. Names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them (Exophase and PSNProfiles agree on all 55). Guides are this entry's own words; each trophy names its sources.

sourcesLegend.exophase: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list: official names, descriptions, grades, hidden flags
sourcesLegend.psnprofiles: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list: PSN progress counts (targets)
sourcesLegend.powerpyx: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap: difficulty, missables, 100% requirements

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum lands on its own once the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Follow the roadmap in order: story first, then the open-world sweep, then the 100% clean-up. PowerPyx rates the whole platinum 4/10 and about 200 hours, with no online trophies at all.
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies.
Check the roadmap's Stage 3 for the 100% requirements that unlock last.
trophies.missNote: Cannot be missed: it unlocks automatically with the other 54.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, earned by finishing the opening mission Gone Fishing. It unlocks through normal story play in Chapter 1, so just keep playing the story. Nothing here can be missed.
steps: Play the story until the opening mission, Gone Fishing, is complete.
trophies.missNote: Not missable: story mission, always available.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 1. Play every story mission in the chapter; the trophy pops at the chapter's end. While you are in Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude — PowerPyx flags that spot as the one thing that may not come back later.
steps: Finish all story missions in Chapter 1.
Before leaving Chapter 1, meditate at the balcony spot (see Positive Mental Attitude).
trophies.missNote: Not missable: chapter completion, always available.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 2. Keep playing the story missions in order; it pops when the chapter closes. Make a manual save at the start of the chapter — the game has no mission replay, so a manual save is your only way back.
steps: Finish all story missions in Chapter 2.
Make a manual save at the chapter start, in case you want to revisit it.
trophies.missNote: Not missable: chapter completion, always available.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 3. Play the chapter's story missions through to the end. Manual saves at each chapter start are the safety net here, because there is no mission replay.
steps: Finish all story missions in Chapter 3.
Keep a manual save from the chapter start.
trophies.missNote: Not missable: chapter completion, always available.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 4. Finish the chapter's story missions; the trophy pops at the chapter's end. Same advice as the other chapters: a manual save at the chapter start, since missions cannot be replayed.
steps: Finish all story missions in Chapter 4.
Keep a manual save from the chapter start.
trophies.missNote: Not missable: chapter completion, always available.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Gold story trophy for finishing the final mission — the end of the story, in Chapter 5. There is only one final mission to play, so finish it and the gold is yours. After the story ends, free-roam stays open, so every remaining trophy can still be earned.
steps: Play through Chapter 5 to the final mission and complete it.
After the credits, keep playing in free-roam for the clean-up stages.
trophies.missNote: Not missable: the final mission is part of the story.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission Breakfast Run. Play the mission when the story offers it and finish it; the trophy pops on completion. Story missions cannot be missed.
steps: Play the story mission Breakfast Run to completion.
trophies.missNote: Not missable: story mission, always available.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission The Cartel Heist. Finish that heist mission when the story reaches it. Heist missions are story beats, so this one comes to you — no searching needed.
steps: Play the story mission The Cartel Heist to completion.
trophies.missNote: Not missable: story mission, always available.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission Child's Play. Complete the mission when the story offers it; the trophy pops at the end of it.
steps: Play the story mission Child's Play to completion.
trophies.missNote: Not missable: story mission, always available.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission Headliners. Finish the mission as part of the story and the trophy is yours.
steps: Play the story mission Headliners to completion.
trophies.missNote: Not missable: story mission, always available.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission VCIA Takedown, set around Vice City International Airport. Complete the mission when the story reaches it.
steps: Play the story mission VCIA Takedown to completion.
trophies.missNote: Not missable: story mission, always available.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission Operation Savage Glory. Finish the mission in story order and the trophy pops.
steps: Play the story mission Operation Savage Glory to completion.
trophies.missNote: Not missable: story mission, always available.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Gold for reaching 100% completion — the last big gate before the platinum. PowerPyx lists what the 100% checklist needs: scan 200 of the 277 vehicles, study 100 of the 255 animals, finish 70 of the 80 challenges, and meditate at 15 of the 18 spots, on top of the story and the other completion tasks. Track each count in the planner below and mop them up in free-roam after the story.
steps: Finish the story, then work the 100% checklist in free-roam.
Scan 200/277 vehicles, study 100/255 animals, finish 70/80 challenges, meditate at 15/18 spots.
Watch the in-game completion percentage and close the remaining tasks.
trophies.missNote: Not missable: free-roam stays open after the story, so 100% can always be finished — except the Chapter 1 meditation spot (see Positive Mental Attitude).

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Silver for pulling off 250 stunts — jumps, near-misses, drifts and other driving feats, counted by PSN up to 250. This is a grind best done naturally while driving everywhere, then finished deliberately in free-roam: pick a fast car, chain jumps off ramps and hills, and let the counter climb. Use the counter on this page to track your progress.
steps: Drive everywhere during the story and let stunts add up.
In free-roam, chain jumps and drifts until the PSN counter hits 250.
trophies.missNote: Not missable: stunts can be done any time in free-roam.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once — one taste of everything the state offers, from races and fishing to the shooting range and the arcade. You do not need to win or master any of them; starting one of each type is enough. The activity list on the planner page is a handy checklist for the nine.
steps: Open the planner and tick off one session of each of the 9 activity types.
Any activity you already tried during the story counts.
trophies.missNote: Not missable: every activity stays available in free-roam.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Silver for a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges (PSN's count). Visit a shooting range, work through its challenges weapon by weapon, and replay any that fall short of gold until they pass. Take your time: accuracy and steady aim beat speed, and every challenge can be retried as often as you like.
steps: Go to a Shooting Range and open its challenge list.
Earn gold on all 42 challenges, replaying any that miss gold.
trophies.missNote: Not missable: challenges can be retried any time.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location is its own race, so work through the map one site at a time and learn the course before pushing for the win. A loss costs nothing — just race the location again.
steps: Find the Top Fun drone races across the map.
Win one race at each of the 14 locations.
trophies.missNote: Not missable: races can be retried any time.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — 20 distinct race events, not the same race 20 times. Mix race types and locations as you go; each new event you win adds one to the count. Keep a note of which you have won so you do not repeat one by mistake.
steps: Race at new locations and in new event types.
Win 20 different race events in total.
trophies.missNote: Not missable: races stay available in free-roam.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at a fishing spot, take his challenge, and out-fish him — steady reeling and watching the line matter more than rushing. If he wins, challenge him again.
steps: Meet Cal at a fishing spot and accept his challenge.
Out-fish him to win the challenge.
trophies.missNote: Not missable: the challenge can be retried.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — play any arcade cabinet through to its end. Pick a game you enjoy, learn its pattern, and finish a full run. No high score is needed, just a completed game.
steps: Find an arcade and pick a cabinet.
Play one arcade game through to completion.
trophies.missNote: Not missable: arcades stay open in free-roam.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand through to his final mission. Stranger and contact strands unlock as you meet people across Leonida — keep playing Andy's missions whenever they appear, and the final one pops this trophy. PowerPyx and the official list agree this is a story-adjacent strand, not a missable one.
steps: Follow Andy's mission strand whenever it appears.
Complete his final mission.
trophies.missNote: Not missable per PowerPyx: contact strands stay available.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand through to his final mission. Play his missions in order as they appear across the state; the last one earns the trophy. Like the other contact finals, it stays available until done.
steps: Follow Kenton's mission strand whenever it appears.
Complete his final mission.
trophies.missNote: Not missable per PowerPyx: contact strands stay available.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand through to his final mission. Keep taking Billy's missions as they show up and complete the last one for the trophy.
steps: Follow Billy's mission strand whenever it appears.
Complete his final mission.
trophies.missNote: Not missable per PowerPyx: contact strands stay available.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Silver for completing 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Explore the map, meet the strangers marked for you, and finish each strand you start — eight completed strands earn it. The five contact finals (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) are strands too, so they count toward the eight.
steps: Explore Leonida and start stranger mission strands.
Complete 8 full strands, including the contact finals.
trophies.missNote: Not missable: stranger strands stay available in free-roam.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand through to his final mission. Take his missions as they appear and complete the last one for the trophy.
steps: Follow Randy's mission strand whenever it appears.
Complete his final mission.
trophies.missNote: Not missable per PowerPyx: contact strands stay available.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand through to his final mission. Play his missions in order as they appear; the final one pops the trophy.
steps: Follow Tyrone's mission strand whenever it appears.
Complete his final mission.
trophies.missNote: Not missable per PowerPyx: contact strands stay available.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida — and do the Chapter 1 balcony spot FIRST. PowerPyx flags this as the game's one potentially missable trophy: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 may be gone after that chapter, and whether it is required for the trophy is not yet confirmed. Do it before Chapter 1 ends, then find the other 17 spots as you explore. For 100% completion only 15 of the 18 spots are needed, but this trophy wants every spot.
steps: In Chapter 1, meditate at Lucia's balcony spot before the chapter ends.
Then meditate at the other 17 spots across Leonida.
trophies.missNote: POTENTIALLY MISSABLE — the only one PowerPyx flags. The Chapter 1 balcony spot may vanish after Chapter 1; whether it is required is not yet confirmed. Meditate there in Chapter 1 and keep a manual save.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Find Bret, take his hunt, and track the animal he names — a unique animal, not a common one. Approach quietly, use the right weapon for a clean hunt, and bring the result back to Bret. PowerPyx's 100% list separately asks you to study 100 of the 255 animals, so hunting pairs well with studying wildlife as you travel.
steps: Find Bret and take his hunting task.
Track and hunt the unique animal he names.
trophies.missNote: Not missable: the hunt stays available in free-roam.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Silver for completing 3 collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida — pick them up as you explore, and trade or find the missing ones to finish three full sets. Cards never disappear, so this is a patient collection job for the free-roam sweep.
steps: Collect cards wherever you explore Leonida.
Complete 3 full card sets.
trophies.missNote: Not missable: cards stay where they are until collected.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Silver for using WAiNK It at 100 locations (PSN's count). WAiNK spots are spread across the map — use the feature at each new location you visit and the counter climbs. Fold it into your exploration: every time you reach a new area, WAiNK It there before moving on.
steps: Use WAiNK It at each new location you visit.
Repeat until the PSN counter reaches 100.
trophies.missNote: Not missable: locations stay available in free-roam.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the small goals scattered through activities and exploration — take the easy ones first (driving, shooting, exploration) and let the count build. PowerPyx notes 80 challenges exist in total and 70 count toward 100%, so finishing 50 here leaves you well on the way to both.
steps: Take on challenges across activities and exploration.
Complete 50 of them; the counter on this page tracks it.
trophies.missNote: Not missable: challenges stay available in free-roam.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while playing with your partner, then escape. Build heat with your partner beside you until four stars show, then break line of sight, hide, and wait for the wanted level to cool off — do not get caught. If you are busted, just build the heat again and retry.
steps: With your partner, raise your wanted level to 4 stars.
Escape and stay hidden until the heat is gone.
trophies.missNote: Not missable: wanted levels can be raised any time.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Plan a route past three shops, hit them one after another with your partner, and keep the wanted level alive between robberies — losing it resets the chain. A fast getaway car parked nearby helps a lot.
steps: Plan a route past 3 shops with your partner.
Rob all 3 in a row without losing your wanted level.
trophies.missNote: Not missable: shops can be robbed again any time.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — get in or scan new vehicle models as you meet them on the road, and the count grows. PowerPyx's 100% list asks for 200 of the 277 vehicles scanned, so discovering 100 here is the halfway mark on a longer job: keep scanning every new model you see.
steps: Discover new vehicle models as you travel.
Reach 100 discovered; keep going to 200 scanned for 100%.
trophies.missNote: Not missable: vehicles keep appearing in free-roam.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a fight with a crowd of enemies, trigger Combat Focus, and drop five before it ends — pick a spot where enemies cluster and keep your aim steady. If you fall short, the next big fight is another try.
steps: Find a fight with several enemies grouped together.
Trigger Combat Focus and take down 5 before it ends.
trophies.missNote: Not missable: fights with grouped enemies keep happening.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — leave Vice City International Airport in a way no timetable planned. Grab a plane at the airport and take off without following a scheduled flight. The official description is the whole clue; no specific aircraft is named by the sources, so any plane departure from VCIA counts as the attempt.
steps: Go to VCIA airport.
Take a plane and depart without a scheduled flight.
trophies.missNote: Not missable: the airport stays open in free-roam.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description is a joke about Rhinos — the tanks. This trophy is about the Rhino tank: get into one and put it through its paces. The official description names no exact act, so the honest guide is: find a Rhino, drive it, and use it until the trophy pops. Not yet verified in game — the exact trigger is not pinned down by the sources.
steps: Find a Rhino tank.
Drive and use it until the trophy pops.
trophies.missNote: Not missable: tanks and free-roam stay available. Exact trigger not yet verified in game.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: avoid cameras and sightlines, take the goods, and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, leave and try again — detection, not the robbery itself, is what fails it.
steps: Pick a jewelry store and plan a quiet approach.
Rob it and leave without being detected.
trophies.missNote: Not missable: jewelry stores can be robbed again.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Silver for robbing 5 bank vaults and escaping each time. Plan each vault: get in, take the money, and escape cleanly — the escape counts as much as the robbery. Five successful vault jobs earn it; a failed escape just means the next vault is another attempt.
steps: Rob a bank vault and escape.
Repeat until 5 vaults are robbed and escaped.
trophies.missNote: Not missable: bank vaults stay available in free-roam.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Watch for armored trucks on the road, stop one, take its cargo, and get away clean before the law closes in. Trucks keep spawning, so a failed attempt is just practice for the next one.
steps: Find an armored truck on the road.
Rob it and escape.
trophies.missNote: Not missable: armored trucks keep spawning.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida (PSN's count). Drive, fly and walk into every corner of the map — the count ticks up per area visited. Pair it with the other exploration jobs: scan vehicles, WAiNK It at new spots, and meditate wherever you stop, so one trip covers several trophies.
steps: Travel to every corner of the map.
Visit all 52 areas; the counter tracks it.
trophies.missNote: Not missable: the whole map stays open in free-roam.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs (PSN's count). Find each gang's operations across the state and hit one per gang — nine gangs, nine robberies. Keep a note of which gangs you have hit so none is repeated by mistake.
steps: Find illegal operations across Leonida.
Rob one operation for each of the 9 gangs.
trophies.missNote: Not missable: gang operations stay available in free-roam.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to Ocean Beach, find a spot to order a cocktail, and take in the view. PowerPyx lists this trophy as not yet known — the exact bar or trigger is not confirmed — so the guide is only what the official description says: a cocktail, with a view, on Ocean Beach. Labelled not yet verified in game; do not trust a guessed location.
steps: Go to Ocean Beach.
Order a cocktail at a beach spot with a view.
trophies.missNote: Not missable as far as the sources say; the exact trigger is not yet known (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through a showroom's glass and out the other side — the classic GTA exit. PowerPyx lists this trophy as not yet known, so the exact showroom is not confirmed by the sources; try a showroom in free-roam and expect the trophy on a full smash-through exit. Not yet verified in game.
steps: Find a vehicle showroom.
Drive a car in and smash your way out through the glass.
trophies.missNote: Not missable as far as the sources say; the exact showroom is not yet known (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go to that bowling alley, play a game of bowling, and follow through on your throws — a full game there is the attempt. The alley's name is in the official description, so this one is pinned down better than most hidden trophies.
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Play a full game of bowling there.
trophies.missNote: Not missable: the bowling alley stays open in free-roam.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal — the official description gives no place, no count and no act, so no honest guide can name one. PowerPyx lists this trophy among the not yet known ones. It is most likely tied to a partnership moment with your partner, so keep playing the partner content and watch for it; labelled not yet verified in game, and no step here is invented.
steps: Keep playing partner content across the story and free-roam.
Watch for a partnership moment with wide appeal.
trophies.missNote: Not missable as far as the sources say; the trigger is not yet known (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse — PSN tracks a count up to 500. Make choices as you play: dialogue picks, side decisions, the small calls the game keeps offering. The count builds across the whole game, so just keep choosing; it is a long grind, not a single moment. Not yet verified in game which choices count.
steps: Keep making choices — dialogue and side decisions — as you play.
Build the PSN count toward 500 across the whole game.
trophies.missNote: Not missable: choices keep coming through the story and free-roam.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The official description hints at succeeding on a second attempt at something — but PowerPyx lists this trophy as not yet known, and no source names what the attempt is. No location or step can honestly be given yet; labelled not yet verified in game.
steps: No confirmed step yet — the attempt this refers to is not yet known.
Retry things you fail once; the trophy may pop on a second success.
trophies.missNote: Not missable as far as the sources say; the trigger is not yet known (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? The description points at witnessing something strange — the kind of odd, unexplained event GTA hides in the world. PowerPyx lists this trophy as not yet known, so no source names the event or its place. Explore odd corners of Leonida and keep an eye out; labelled not yet verified in game, and no event is guessed here.
steps: Explore the stranger corners of Leonida.
No confirmed event yet — the trigger is not yet known.
trophies.missNote: Not missable as far as the sources say; the trigger is not yet known (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl them over with a melee drive-by — knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Drive slowly past a pedestrian, swing a melee weapon from the vehicle, and connect. PowerPyx lists this trophy as not yet known, so the exact target is unconfirmed, but the act itself is named by the official description: a melee drive-by.
steps: Get a melee weapon and a vehicle.
Drive past a pedestrian and knock them down with a melee attack from the vehicle.
trophies.missNote: Not missable: drive-bys can be done any time in free-roam. Exact target not yet verified in game.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from heists and robberies — take them to your contacts to wash them into clean money, and the total adds up toward $250,000. Keep robbing and laundering; the counter is cumulative across the whole game.
steps: Earn marked bills from heists and robberies.
Launder them through your contacts until $250,000 is washed.
trophies.missNote: Not missable: marked bills and contacts stay available.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — weapons, clothes, cars, anything the shops sell. The count is cumulative, so normal shopping across the story adds up; if you are short late in the game, buy big-ticket items you actually want. Money spent is money counted.
steps: Shop normally through the story.
Top up with big purchases until $100,000 is spent in total.
trophies.missNote: Not missable: shops stay open in free-roam.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties (PSN's count). Garages are bought from property listings across Leonida — each one also gives you somewhere to store the vehicles you discover for Whip It Good. Save up, buy them one by one, and the eighth purchase pops the trophy.
steps: Find garage properties for sale across Leonida.
Buy all 8 garage properties.
trophies.missNote: Not missable: properties stay for sale until bought.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles around Leonida, register each one in the app, and repeat until ten are registered. Any vehicle counts, so register the ones you meet on the road as you go.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app.
Register 10 different vehicles through it.
trophies.missNote: Not missable: vehicles keep appearing in free-roam.
